data.one_liner: Image editor plugin with filters, drawing, text, and emojis.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready-to-use widgets for editing images with paint, text, filters, emojis, stickers, and cropping features. It also includes utility functions to convert image formats like jpeg, png, heic, and webp.
use_when: You need a complete story-like image editor interface in your Flutter application.
You need image cropping functionality built into your app.
You need to convert images between different formats such as HEIC, PNG, JPEG, and WebP.
avoid_when: You only need to pick images from the device gallery or camera without editing features.
You need headless backend image processing without UI components.
strengths: Includes full UI screens for image editing and cropping out of the box.
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, web, and Windows.
Provides built-in support for language translation of UI texts.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration permissions for iOS photo library and camera.
Pulls in a large number of external dependencies.
data.setup_notes: For iOS, add NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription, NSCameraUsageDescription, and NSMicrophoneUsageDescription keys to Info.plist.
